dbFindOpenCellViewByName.note: String names. Do not substitute dbFindOpenCellView (library ID) or invent ByType.

geGetEditCellViewWindow.note: Find the target editor directly; avoid probing CIW/non-editor windows.

dbIsCellViewModified.note: Use this API, not an invented cv~>modified attribute.

schCheck.note: A non-nil list is not success. Connectivity can change; verify invariants afterward.

dbSave.note: Use the managed --save gate instead of calling this from a job.

drain.note: SKILL stream flushing; fflush is not the installed SKILL API.

dbTransformBBox.note: Use cadexPin for a single symbol pin; inspect multi-shape pins explicitly.

schCreateWire.note: The cadexWire recipe encapsulates the UF schematic call verified in a real job.

vfoSetParam.note: Use cadexParam; preserve device-specific CDF types, units, expressions, and callbacks.
